items.title_en: Microsoft Expands In-House AI Chip Production, Said to Secure Over 300,000 Maia 300 Orders from TSMC
paras: 根據《The Information》周一 (10 日) 報導，微軟 (Microsoft)(MSFT-US) 計劃大幅提高自家人工智慧 (AI) 晶片產量。
報導引述知情人士指出，微軟最快可能在下個月推出 Maia 300 晶片。據報，微軟已與晶圓代工廠台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 進行討論，計劃訂購超過 30 萬顆 Maia 300，預計在 2027 年交貨。
微軟 Azure Maia 總經理 Andrew Wall 向《巴隆周刊》表示，「微軟持續投資客製化晶片，這是我們長期 AI 基礎建設策略的一環。我們不會透露生產量，但報導中的數字並未反映我們整體計畫的規模。」
Wall 進一步表示，微軟預期「Azure Maia 的部署將支援以 GW 計算的 AI 工作負載需求」。
微軟股價周一上漲 1.1%，台積電 ADR 股價則小幅收低 0.37%。
微軟最初在 2023 年 11 月推出 Maia 晶片，接著在今年 1 月推出 Maia 200。隨著 AI 運算需求大幅攀升，晶片供應持續吃緊、成本不斷上升，因此微軟希望擴大自研晶片產量並不令人意外。
全球科技巨頭正投入數千億美元，建置支撐 AI 運算所需的基礎設施。在如此龐大的資本支出環境下，自行開發晶片並降低成本變得相當重要，尤其是這些科技公司目前高度依賴單一半導體業者輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 提供 AI 晶片。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google Cloud 已開發自家 Tensor Processing Unit(TPU)，而亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 旗下 Amazon Web Services(AWS) 則提供 Trainium AI 加速器。
IDC 運算系統平台與技術研究總監 Jim Hines 表示，「微軟發展自有晶片設計能力，反映出超大規模雲端服務商正出現更廣泛的垂直整合趨勢。面對成本上升、電力限制及供應受限等問題，業者正逐步整合 AI 基礎建設的整個技術堆疊。」
paras_en: According to a report by The Information on Monday (the 10th), Microsoft (MSFT-US) plans to significantly increase the production of its own artificial intelligence (AI) chips.

The report, citing sources familiar with the matter, says Microsoft could launch the Maia 300 chip as early as next month. It adds that Microsoft has been in talks with foundry TSMC (TSM-US)(2330-TW) about ordering more than 300,000 Maia 300 chips, with delivery expected in 2027.

Microsoft Azure Maia General Manager Andrew Wall told Barron's that “Microsoft continues to invest in custom chips as part of our long‑term AI infrastructure strategy. We won’t disclose production volumes, and the figures cited in the report do not reflect the full scale of our plans.”
Wall further said Microsoft expects “Azure Maia deployments to support AI workloads measured in gigawatts of compute demand.”
Microsoft’s stock rose 1.1% on Monday, while TSMC’s ADR slipped 0.37%.

Microsoft first introduced the Maia chip in November 2023 and followed with the Maia 200 in January this year. With AI compute demand soaring, chip supply has remained tight and costs have risen, so it is unsurprising that Microsoft wants to scale up its in‑house chip output.

Tech giants worldwide are pouring tens of billions of dollars into building the infrastructure needed for AI compute. In this massive cap‑ex environment, developing proprietary chips to cut costs is becoming crucial, especially as these companies heavily rely on a single semiconductor supplier, Nvidia (NVDA-US), for AI chips.
Alphabet’s Google Cloud has built its own Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), and Amazon’s AWS offers the Trainium AI accelerator.

IDC’s Director of Computing Systems Platforms and Technologies, Jim Hines, said, “Microsoft’s development of its own chip design capability reflects a broader trend of vertical integration among hyperscale cloud providers. Facing rising costs, power constraints and supply limits, operators are gradually integrating the entire AI infrastructure stack.”

items.title: 蘋果20週年「全玻璃iPhone」傳喊卡 Jefferies下調蘋果評等
items.title_en: Apple Cancels 20th Anniversary 'All-Glass iPhone' Plan, Jefferies Downgrades Apple Rating
paras: 多家外媒報導，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 傳出已取消為 iPhone 問世 20 週年打造的「全玻璃 iPhone」。Jefferies 認為，這項計畫可能因量產良率不佳而喊停，不僅讓蘋果失去推出超高價 iPhone 的機會，也更難透過產品升級抵銷記憶體成本上漲。
Jefferies 分析師 Edison Lee 週一 (10 日) 將蘋果評等由「持有」降至「表現不如大盤」，相當於「賣出」，並將目標價從 285.56 美元下修至 263.66 美元，成為華爾街較低的目標價之一。
受此消息衝擊，蘋果週一下滑約 1.5% 至每股 308.26 美元。
市場早在 2025 年便傳出，蘋果可能於 2027 年 9 月推出全玻璃 iPhone，紀念 iPhone 上市 20 週年。雖然蘋果從未證實這項計畫，但公司早在 2019 年曾申請「六面玻璃機殼」專利。
Lee 表示，最新供應鏈調查顯示，全玻璃 iPhone 可能因生產良率過低而取消。所謂良率，是指生產過程中符合品質標準的產品比例；良率太低將推高成本，甚至使產品難以量產。
Jefferies 估計，這款紀念機種若如期推出，綜合平均零售價可能達 2,060 美元，超越歷來所有 iPhone。蘋果原本也可能將全玻璃設計延伸至後續 Pro 及 Pro Max 機種，進一步提高平均售價和利潤率。
Lee 認為，計畫喊停正值記憶體價格大漲之際，對蘋果尤其不利。蘋果若缺少重大外觀升級，可能更難說服消費者接受漲價，零組件成本上升也將加重毛利率壓力。
另一方面，供應鏈消息顯示，蘋果正考慮將 2027 年 iPhone 19 Pro Max 的記憶體由 12GB 提高至 16GB，以支援更複雜的裝置端 AI 運算。
然而，Lee 指出，Apple Intelligence 推廣速度仍然緩慢，現階段未必足以證明升級記憶體的成本合理。若 AI 功能無法帶來明顯的使用價值，蘋果可能難以將增加的成本轉嫁給消費者。
paras_en: Multiple media outlets reported that Apple (AAPL-US) has canceled plans for an 'all-glass iPhone' to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's release. Jefferies believes that the project may have been halted due to poor production yields, not only depriving Apple of the opportunity to launch a high-priced iPhone but also making it more difficult to offset rising memory costs through product upgrades.

Jefferies analyst Edison Lee downgraded Apple's rating to 'underperform' from 'hold' on Monday (10th), equivalent to 'sell', and lowered his target price to $263.66 from $285.56, making it one of the lowest target prices on Wall Street.
Apple's stock fell about 1.5% to $308.26 per share on Monday.

The market had been speculating since 2025 that Apple might launch an all-glass iPhone in September 2027 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's release. Although Apple has never confirmed the plan, the company had filed a patent for a 'six-sided glass casing' as early as 2019.

Lee stated that the latest supply chain investigation showed that the all-glass iPhone may be canceled due to low production yields. Production yields refer to the proportion of products that meet quality standards during the production process; low yields would increase costs and make it difficult to produce the product.

Jefferies estimates that if the commemorative model is launched as planned, the average retail price could reach $2,060, surpassing all previous iPhones. Apple had also considered extending the all-glass design to subsequent Pro and Pro Max models, further increasing average sales prices and profit margins.

Lee believes that the plan's cancellation comes at a time when memory prices are rising, which is particularly unfavorable to Apple. Without significant design upgrades, Apple may find it harder to convince consumers to accept price increases, and rising component costs would also put pressure on profit margins.
On the other hand, supply chain information shows that Apple is considering increasing the memory of the 2027 iPhone 19 Pro Max from 12GB to 16GB to support more complex device-end AI computations.

However, Lee pointed out that Apple's AI promotion speed is still slow, and it is not yet clear whether the cost of upgrading memory is reasonable. If AI functionality cannot bring obvious value to users, Apple may find it difficult to pass on the increased costs to consumers.

items.title: SpaceX解禁後飆16%股價續揚 下波7%禁售股8/20登場
items.title_en: SpaceX Soars 16% After Lockup Expiration, Next Wave of 7% Lockup on August 20
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周一 (10 日) 再度收高。上周五因首波禁售期屆滿而大漲 16%，創下近一個月來最高收盤價，周一延續漲勢。
這家由馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 執掌、聚焦衛星及人工智慧 (AI) 業務的公司，股價周一收漲 4.2%，報 138.74 美元。
SpaceX 自 6 月 16 日創下 201.80 美元的收盤歷史高點後，股價表現相當疲弱。該高點是在 6 月 12 日 IPO 後不久創下，截至上周五收盤，股價較當時的歷史高點下跌約 30%。
華爾街原本普遍預期，周四首波禁售期屆滿、約 9.11 億股受限制的內部人士持股解禁後，市場將面臨沉重賣壓。然而，市場預期的大規模內部人士拋售並未出現。賣壓缺席讓放空 SpaceX 的投資人措手不及，進而引發一波回補空頭持股的買盤，同時吸引原本觀望的機構投資人逢低買進。
在首波解禁之前，SpaceX 僅約 5% 的股票能在公開市場自由交易，因此市場流動性嚴重不足，股價波動也相當劇烈。隨著可自由交易的股票增加至超過 15 億股，市場交易瓶頸獲得緩解，大型機構基金得以建立大量持股，而不必大幅推升交易成本。
花旗周一在報告中重申 SpaceX 股票 200 美元的目標價，並上調 2026 及 2027 年的財務預測，預期公司到 2031 年營收將達約 1 兆美元。SpaceX 則表示，預計 2030 年就能達成這項里程碑。
花旗分析師表示，他們「對管理層願景的信心高於市場共識」。
上周市場情緒也受到另一項消息提振。SpaceX 與特斯拉 (Tesla)(TSLA-US) 宣布，將共同投資 168 億美元，在德州葛林姆斯郡 (Grimes County) 興建半導體工廠 Terafab。
這座專門設計的工廠將生產自家 AI 晶片，供特斯拉的機器人產品，以及 SpaceX 的太空型資料中心網路使用。
鑑於首波禁售期屆滿後的市場反應，華爾街在面對下一波解禁時將更加謹慎，而投資人只需再等待 10 天。
第二波解禁將在 8 月 20 日開盤前生效，屆時市場將新增約 7% 的受限制股票，這些股份主要由員工及 IPO 前的一般股東持有。
如果這次真的出現市場上次預期、但最終未發生的大規模內部人士拋售，SpaceX 股價波動可能再度升溫。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) shares rose again on Monday (10th) after the first wave of lockup expiration. The company's shares surged 16% last Friday, reaching a new high of 138.74 US dollars, continuing the upward trend.
Led by Elon Musk, the company focuses on satellite and artificial intelligence (AI) businesses. Its shares rose 4.2% on Monday, reaching 138.74 US dollars.

Since reaching a record high of 201.80 US dollars on June 16, SpaceX's stock performance has been relatively weak. The high point was set just after the IPO on June 12, and as of last Friday's close, the stock price had fallen about 30% from its historical high.

Initially, Wall Street expected a massive sell-off by insiders when the first wave of lockup expiration took place on Thursday, with approximately 911 million shares restricted. However, the anticipated large-scale insider selling did not materialize.

The absence of selling pressure allowed short sellers to cover their positions, attracting institutional investors who bought in at lower prices. This led to a surge in buying activity, with investors who had been waiting on the sidelines joining the market.

Before the first wave of lockup expiration, only about 5% of SpaceX's shares were freely traded on the public market, resulting in severe liquidity shortages and extreme price volatility. With the increase in freely tradable shares to over 1.5 billion, market bottlenecks were alleviated, allowing large institutional funds to build significant positions without significantly increasing trading costs.

Morgan Stanley reiterated its target price of 200 US dollars for SpaceX shares on Monday and raised its financial forecasts for 2026 and 2027, expecting the company's revenue to reach approximately 1 trillion US dollars by 2031. SpaceX expects to achieve this milestone by 2030.
Morgan Stanley analysts stated that they have 'higher confidence in management's vision than the market consensus.'

Last week, the market was also boosted by another piece of news. SpaceX and Tesla (TSLA-US) announced a joint investment of 168 billion US dollars to build a semiconductor factory, Terafab, in Grimes County, Texas.
This specialized factory will produce AI chips for Tesla's robotic products and SpaceX's space-based data center network.
Given the market's reaction to the first wave of lockup expiration, Wall Street will be more cautious when facing the next wave of lockup expiration. Investors only need to wait 10 more days.

The second wave of lockup expiration will take effect before the market opens on August 20, adding approximately 7% of restricted shares to the market, mainly held by employees and pre-IPO common shareholders.

items.title: 美股還有進一步上漲空間？漲勢不再靠AI巨頭撐盤、標普500「以廣帶漲」
paras: 表面上看，美股近期的紀錄新高似乎仍是由少數科技巨擘撐起，但深入檢視盤面結構可發現，這波漲勢的參與廣度其實遠超外界想像，而這股「以廣帶漲」的趨勢還有進一步擴大的空間。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，今年稍早，市場一度憂心漲勢過度集中在少數與人工智慧（AI）相關的超大型科技股身上，擔心一旦這些個股回檔，整體指數將難以支撐。
但最新數據顯示，情勢已明顯轉變，參與上漲的個股數量正持續增加。
以市值加權的標普 500 指數上週五（7 日）收在歷史新高，寫下自四月以來最佳單週表現，今年以來累計上漲 13.3%。
相較之下，根據道瓊市場數據，採取平均權重配置的 Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Financials ETF(RSPF-US) ，同期漲幅達 15%。這代表，等權重 ETF 今年可望自 2022 年以來首度跑贏市值加權的標普 500 指數。
而在標普 500 成分股中，今年共有 226 檔、約占 45% 的個股表現優於大盤指數，同樣是 2022 年以來最高比例，一改過去三年僅約三分之一或更少個股跑贏指數的局面。
分析人士指出，漲勢擴散代表指數型基金的報酬不再只仰賴少數 AI 概念股，也顯示市場動能可能來自更廣泛的因素，包括企業獲利穩健與經濟持續成長，而不僅限於 AI 題材本身。
問題在於，這股趨勢能否延續。
對此，數位財富管理公司 Moneyfarm 首席投資長 Richard Flax 指出，部分經濟強韌性其實源自 AI 相關資本支出對整體經濟的外溢帶動效果，顯示 AI 投資的效益已不再局限於科技股本身。
這股力道也持續推升標普 500 指數屢創新高，部分市場人士認為漲勢仍有續航空間。
根據 FactSet 數據，市值加權標普 500 指數目前本益比略高於 20 倍（以未來 12 個月獲利計算）；但富蘭克林坦伯頓投資組合經理 Jonathan Curtis 指出，等權重標普 500 指數本益比僅約 17 倍，接近其近 20 年中位數水準。
Curtis 認為，這顯示投資人尚未完全將 AI 帶來的生產力提升反映在一般企業股價上。
他表示：「如果你看等權重指數，市場其實在說『我看不到任何 AI 帶來的生產力提升』，我認為這個看法有誤，AI 很可能會讓美國經濟變得更有生產力。如果投資人相信這一點，就應該買進等權重標普 500 指數，以及那些積極導入 AI 的企業。」
不過，這股廣度擴散的趨勢即將面臨考驗。美國上週五公布的就業數據疲弱，本週還將迎來通膨數據與多家科技巨頭財報。

通膨數據成本週焦點

在上週公布的就業數據後，投資人的目光本週將轉向通膨數據。
儘管 7 月美國就業人數下滑，但通膨問題依然揮之不去，已連續數年高於聯準會 2% 的目標水準。
就業數據公布後，市場對聯準會 9 月 16 日會後升息的預期一度降溫，但這項預期仍可能隨本週數據變化而調整。
Wilsey 資產管理公司首席投資長 Brent Wilsey 表示，上週五疲弱的非農就業數據「應該不太會改變聯準會的立場」，但確實「提高了」本週數據的重要性。
他指出，受下半月油價走高影響，週三（12 日）上午公布的 7 月消費者物價指數（CPI）可能出現反彈。
市場預期 7 月 CPI 月增 0.3%，前值為持平，年增率預估達 3.4%。至於週四（13 日）公布的生產者物價指數（PPI），預估月增 0.2%，上月則為下滑 0.3%。

財報季進入尾聲 少數指標股仍受矚目

隨著標普 500 成分股已有 88% 完成財報公布，本週財報密集度將明顯放緩，但仍有幾檔指標股值得留意。
光通訊廠商 Lumentum(LITE-US) 預計於週二（11 日）收盤後公布財報。儘管公司規模遠不及超大型科技股，但由於該股今年以來大漲 141.5%，是標普 500 指數今年表現第八佳的個股，市場仍高度關注其財報表現。
根據 FactSet 預估，其每股盈餘估將較去年同期成長逾兩倍至 2.97 美元，營收則預估倍增至 9.877 億美元。
另外，思科系統 (CSCO-US) 預計於週三收盤後公布財報。FactSet 預估其每股盈餘將自去年同期的 0.99 美元成長至 1.17 美元，分析師並預期營收將年增 14.6% 至 168.2 億美元。

items.title: 〈財報〉川普媒體Q2巨虧2.38億美元！營收雖增89% 仍難敵加密資產暴跌
items.title_en: <Financial Report> Trump Media Q2 Losses $238.1 Million; Revenue Up 89% Yet Still Can't Offset Crypto Crash
paras: 川普旗下媒體公司 Trump Media & Technology Group(TMTG) (DJT-US) 周一 (10 日) 公布 2026 年第 2 季財報，受數位資產及股票投資價值下跌拖累，單季淨損擴大至 2.381 億美元，遠高於去年同期約 2000 萬美元虧損；營收則僅 170 萬美元，雖年增 89%, 但與巨額虧損相比仍顯得微不足道。
TMTG 表示，截至 6 月 30 日止第 2 季，淨損主要來自非現金資產價值下降，其中數位資產、質押數位資產及股權證券相關損失合計約 1.904 億美元。此外，公司還認列約 1170 萬美元的利息累增及 810 萬美元的股票薪酬等費用。
公司第 2 季調整後 EBITDA 虧損也達 2.235 億美元，顯示即使排除部分非現金項目的影響，核心營運仍處於大幅虧損狀態。TMTG 同時表示，截至第 2 季末，公司總資產約 20 億美元，其中金融資產約 19 億美元，包括現金、受限制現金、短期投資、股權證券、應收票據及利息、數位資產及質押數位資產等。
營收方面，TMTG 第 2 季營收約 170 萬美元，較去年同期約 90 萬美元增加 89%。絕大部分收入來自旗下社群平台 Truth Social 的廣告服務，顯示公司目前仍高度依賴規模有限的媒體業務，而數位資產價格波動對整體財務結果的影響遠大於傳統廣告營收。
TMTG 財務長 Phillip Juhan 在公司首次舉行的財報電話會議中表示，公司營運費用很大程度受到數位資產價格波動影響。第 2 季營運費用超過 1.65 億美元，較去年同期增加約 275%, 進一步擴大公司獲利壓力。
其中，法律支出仍是營運費用的重要來源之一。公司表示，第 2 季用於營運活動的現金約為 1370 萬美元，其中約 2560 萬美元與法律費用有關，主要涉及過去累積的訴訟案件。不過，TMTG 表示，多項歷史法律問題已大致獲得解決，未來法律相關支出可望明顯下降。
TMTG 目前也正試圖降低對加密貨幣業務的依賴。公司近期終止與 Crypto.com 及 Yorkville Acquisition Corp. 相關的多項交易，原先計畫利用 Crypto.com 的 Cronos 區塊鏈及 CRO 代幣建立加密貨幣策略業務。TMTG 目前則將更多資源重新導向 Truth Social 的媒體、資料授權及其他核心業務。
在數位資產價格下跌對財報造成重大衝擊之際，公司正推出新的變現方式，其中最受矚目的是 Truth API。
TMTG 表示，Truth API 已在 8 月 1 日正式推出，主要向機構客戶提供 Truth Social 內容的快速資料串流，讓高頻交易公司及其他金融機構能比一般使用者更快取得平台上的重要貼文。
TMTG 在財報中透露，目前已簽署超過 10 份 Truth API 客戶協議，客戶主要為高頻交易公司。公司證實，相關服務收費約為每月 6 萬至 10 萬美元，長期合約可取得較低價格。
換言之，如果目前超過 10 家客戶均按照最低每月 6 萬美元的價格付費，Truth API 至少已形成每月 60 萬美元以上的潛在經常性收入；若全部按照每月 10 萬美元的價格計算，月收入則可達 100 萬美元以上。不過，公司並未公布每一家客戶的實際合約金額，因此目前不能將上述金額視為已實現營收。
Truth API 的商業模式也引發市場及政治層面的爭議。TMTG 先前宣布，將向銀行、交易公司及其他機構提供 Truth Social 上最具影響力帳號的高速資料，可能包括川普的貼文。由於川普經常透過 Truth Social 發布可能影響金融市場的政策訊息，批評者質疑，這項服務是否會讓付費機構取得其他市場參與者沒有的資訊速度優勢。
TMTG 則主張，Truth API 只是將公開發布於 Truth Social 的內容以更快、更可靠的方式提供給機構客戶，並強調其目標是縮小資料延遲，而非提供未公開資訊。
Truth Social 本身仍面臨流量規模及廣告變現能力的挑戰。近期市場報導指出，Truth Social 的網站及應用程式流量今年夏季明顯下滑，與 X 等大型社群平台相比，整體用戶規模仍相對有限。這使得 TMTG 即使成功提高廣告營收，仍難以單靠傳統社群媒體模式支撐目前的企業規模。
因此，TMTG 目前正嘗試把 Truth Social 從單純的社群平台轉變成多元化數位資產，包括內容串流、資料授權、金融服務及加密貨幣等業務。
其中 Truth + 影音服務目前已進入全面商業化階段，TMTG 也表示 Truth Social 正在擴大內容布局。公司希望藉由增加內容及服務種類，提高平台使用時間及廣告價值，並尋找除了廣告之外的收入來源。
TMTG 的另一項重大戰略則是與核融合能源公司 TAE Technologies 的合併。雙方去年 12 月宣布達成一項全股票交易，交易估值超過 60 億美元，合併後雙方股東在完全稀釋基礎上預計各持有約 50% 的合併公司股份。合併交易被 TMTG 視為未來長期股東價值的重要來源。
TMTG 與 TAE Technologies 今年 6 月表示，雙方仍以盡快完成合併為目標，預計最晚在 2026 年第 4 季或更早完成交易。雙方同時放棄原先將 Truth Social 等媒體資產分拆成獨立上市公司的計畫。
這項策略轉變顯示，TMTG 目前並不打算將 Truth Social 單獨拆分，而是希望將媒體平台與 TAE 的核融合能源技術整合，打造涵蓋媒體、科技及能源的企業架構。
TMTG 臨時執行長 Kevin McGurn 表示，公司目前正逐步集中資源於成長計畫，並認為與 TAE Technologies 的合併是推動長期股東價值最重要的因素之一。公司同時希望透過 Truth+、Truth Social 及 Truth API 等業務改善營收結構。
不過，對投資人而言，TMTG 最大的問題仍是營收與估值之間的巨大落差。第 2 季營收僅 170 萬美元，卻出現 2.381 億美元淨損，意味著公司目前的資產價值、加密貨幣投資及未來商業計畫，對整體企業估值的影響遠高於現有媒體業務產生的現金流。
這種財務結構也使 TMTG 的季度獲利容易受到金融市場波動影響。公司第 2 季大部分虧損來自數位資產及股票等金融資產的未實現價值變動，當相關資產價格上升時可能推升帳面價值，但價格下跌時也會迅速放大淨損。
在此之前，TMTG 在 2025 年全年已錄得約 7.123 億美元虧損，當時數位資產價值變動同樣是造成巨額損失的重要因素。近期公司縮減部分加密貨幣計畫，也反映管理層正在重新評估這類業務對企業財務穩定性的影響。
另一方面，川普仍是 TMTG 最具影響力的資產之一。川普透過信託持有公司大量股份，市場也長期將 DJT 股價視為與川普政治影響力及個人品牌高度相關的特殊標的，而非單純依照傳統媒體公司的營收及獲利能力估值。
隨著川普目前仍擔任美國總統，Truth Social 上的政治及政策訊息具備較高市場關注度，這也成為 TMTG 推出 Truth API 的重要商業基礎。但隨著美國總統任期未來走向及平台使用率變化，市場仍將觀察這項特殊流量優勢能否轉化為持久的商業價值。
目前 TMTG 正處於轉型關鍵期。一方面，公司必須降低加密貨幣價格波動對財務報表造成的巨大影響；另一方面，又必須證明 Truth Social、Truth + 及 Truth API 能夠真正建立可持續的營收來源。
如果 Truth API 能持續吸引高頻交易及金融機構客戶，將有機會成為 TMTG 目前規模仍小的廣告業務之外，另一個高毛利收入來源；但若 Truth Social 流量持續下滑，或 Truth API 無法擴大客戶數量，公司仍將面臨核心業務營收不足的問題。
在 TAE Technologies 合併預計於今年第 4 季或更早完成的情況下，TMTG 未來也將逐步從一家以 Truth Social 為核心的政治媒體公司，轉向同時布局媒體、金融科技及核融合能源的複合型企業。這項轉型能否提升企業實際營收及現金流，將成為投資人接下來評估 DJT 的重要關鍵。
paras_en: Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG) (DJT-US) released its 2026 second‑quarter results on Monday (the 10th). Dragged down by declines in digital‑asset and equity‑investment values, the quarterly net loss widened to $238.1 million, far above the roughly $20 million loss a year earlier; revenue was only $1.7 million, up 89% year‑over‑year but still negligible compared with the massive loss.

TMTG said that as of June 30, the net loss was mainly due to the fall in non‑cash asset values, with losses on digital assets, pledged digital assets and equity securities totaling about $190.4 million. In addition, the company recorded roughly $11.7 million of accrued interest and $8.1 million of stock‑based compensation expenses.

Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter was a loss of $223.5 million, showing that even after stripping out some non‑cash items, core operations remain deeply loss‑making. TMTG also noted that total assets at quarter‑end were about $2 billion, of which roughly $1.9 billion were financial assets, including cash, restricted cash, short‑term investments, equity securities, notes and interest receivable, digital assets and pledged digital assets.

Revenue for the quarter was about $1.7 million, up from roughly $900,000 a year earlier, an 89% increase. Almost all of the revenue came from advertising on its social platform Truth Social, indicating the company is still heavily reliant on a relatively small media business, while the impact of digital‑asset price swings on overall financial results dwarfs traditional ad revenue.

Chief Financial Officer Phillip Juhan told participants in the company’s first earnings call that operating expenses were heavily affected by digital‑asset price volatility. Operating expenses exceeded $165 million in the quarter, about 275% higher than a year ago, further squeezing profitability.

Legal costs remained a major component of operating expenses. The company said cash used for operating activities was about $13.7 million, of which roughly $25.6 million related to legal fees tied to past lawsuits. TMTG added that many historic legal issues have largely been resolved and future legal spending should fall markedly.

TMTG is also working to reduce its reliance on crypto‑related business. It recently terminated several deals with Crypto.com and Yorkville Acquisition Corp. that had been intended to build a crypto‑strategy using Crypto.com’s Cronos blockchain and CRO token. The firm is now redirecting resources toward Truth Social’s media, data‑licensing and other core operations.
Amid the sharp hit to the financials from falling digital‑asset prices, the company is rolling out new monetisation methods, the most notable being the Truth API.

TMTG said the Truth API launched on August 1, offering institutional clients fast data streams of Truth Social content so high‑frequency trading firms and other financial institutions can access key posts more quickly than ordinary users.

The filing disclosed that more than ten Truth API customer agreements have been signed, primarily with high‑frequency trading firms. The service is priced at roughly $60,000‑$100,000 per month, with lower rates available under longer‑term contracts.

In other words, if the ten‑plus customers each paid the minimum $60,000 per month, the API would generate at least $600,000 of potential recurring revenue; at the top end of $100,000 per month, monthly revenue could exceed $1 million. The company did not disclose individual contract values, so these figures cannot be treated as realised revenue.

The Truth API business model has sparked debate in both market and political circles. TMTG previously announced it would provide banks, trading firms and other institutions with high‑speed data on the most influential Truth Social accounts, potentially including posts by Trump. Critics argue the service could give paying firms an informational speed advantage unavailable to other market participants, especially since Trump often uses Truth Social to release policy signals that could move markets.

TMTG counters that the Truth API simply delivers publicly posted Truth Social content faster and more reliably to institutional clients, emphasizing that its purpose is to reduce data latency, not to supply non‑public information.

Truth Social itself still faces challenges in traffic volume and ad‑monetisation. Recent market reports note a clear dip in website and app traffic this summer, and the platform’s user base remains modest compared with larger networks such as X, making it difficult for TMTG to sustain its current scale solely on traditional social‑media advertising.

Consequently, TMTG is trying to evolve Truth Social from a pure social platform into a diversified digital‑asset business that includes content streaming, data licensing, financial services and crypto‑related activities.

The Truth + video service has entered full commercialisation, and TMTG says Truth Social is expanding its content portfolio. The firm hopes that by adding more content and service types it can increase user‑time, boost ad value and create revenue streams beyond advertising.

Another major strategic move for TMTG is its planned merger with fusion‑energy company TAE Technologies. The two announced in December last year a all‑stock transaction valued at over $6 billion, with each side expected to own roughly 50% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis. TMTG views the merger as a key source of long‑term shareholder value.

In June this year, TMTG and TAE reiterated their goal of completing the merger as soon as possible, targeting the fourth quarter of 2026 or earlier, and both parties have abandoned the earlier plan to spin off Truth Social and other media assets into a separate public company.

This strategic shift shows TMTG does not intend to split off Truth Social but rather to integrate the media platform with TAE’s fusion‑energy technology, creating a corporate structure that spans media, technology and energy.

Interim CEO Kevin McGurn said the company is gradually concentrating resources on growth initiatives and believes the merger with TAE Technologies is one of the most important drivers of long‑term shareholder value. He added that the firm hopes to improve its revenue mix through Truth +, Truth Social and the Truth API.

Nevertheless, investors’ biggest concern remains the huge gap between revenue and valuation. With only $1.7 million of revenue in Q2 against a $238.1 million net loss, the company’s asset base, crypto holdings and future business plans weigh far more on its valuation than the cash flow generated by its existing media operations.

This financial structure also makes TMTG’s quarterly profitability highly sensitive to market swings. Most of the Q2 loss stemmed from unrealised value changes in digital assets and equity securities; when those prices rise, book value improves, but declines quickly amplify the net loss.

Earlier, TMTG posted a full‑year loss of about $712.3 million in 2025, also driven largely by digital‑asset valuation swings. Recent cuts to some crypto initiatives reflect management’s reassessment of how such activities affect the firm’s financial stability.

On the other hand, Trump remains one of TMTG’s most valuable assets. He holds a large block of shares through a trust, and the market has long priced DJT stock as a special vehicle tied closely to his political influence and personal brand rather than traditional media earnings and profitability metrics.

With Trump still in office, political and policy messages on Truth Social attract heightened market attention, providing a key commercial rationale for the Truth API. However, as the presidential term evolves and platform usage changes, the market will watch whether this unique traffic advantage can translate into lasting commercial value.

TMTG is at a pivotal transformation point. It must both curb the impact of crypto‑price volatility on its statements and demonstrate that Truth Social, Truth + and the Truth API can generate sustainable revenue streams.

If the Truth API continues to attract high‑frequency traders and financial institutions, it could become a high‑margin revenue source beyond the still‑small advertising business. Conversely, if Truth Social traffic keeps falling or the API fails to grow its client base, the firm will still face a shortfall in core‑business revenue.

Assuming the TAE Technologies merger is completed in the fourth quarter of this year or sooner, TMTG will gradually shift from a Trump‑centric political‑media company to a diversified enterprise that spans media, fintech and fusion energy. Whether this transformation can lift actual revenue and cash flow will be a key factor investors consider when evaluating DJT going forward.

items.title: 川普否認頻繁熱線華許 強調「只有短暫一次」
items.title_en: Trump Denies Frequent Calls to Powell, Stresses 'Just One Time'
paras: 美國總統川普週一 (10 日) 證實，近日曾與聯準會主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 短暫通話，但否認兩人自華許上任後頻繁聯繫，試圖淡化外界對白宮干預貨幣政策及聯準會獨立性的疑慮。
《華爾街日報》日前報導，華許今年 5 月接掌聯準會後，已與川普多次交談。川普反駁報導內容，表示兩人只在幾天前短暫談過一次，並非外界所稱的經常通話。
川普說：「他們講得好像我一直和華許通話，但我只跟他談過一次。」
聯準會尚未回應相關報導。
華許先前表示，願意聽取總統或任何人士對利率政策的看法，但最終仍會根據自己的判斷決定政策方向。川普則持續公開要求華許降息，但也承認利率決策並非由主席一人決定。
川普週一表示，如果完全由華許決定，結果可能會不同，「但他還有一個委員會」。聯準會利率政策由聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 集體表決，主席無法單方面決定利率走向。
美國總統與聯準會主席直接接觸，近年相對罕見。川普 2025 年重返白宮後，與前主席鮑爾僅舉行過一次定期正式會議。兩人之後也曾一同視察聯準會總部翻修工程，當時川普指控鮑爾管理工程不當。
除了公開施壓降息，川普上週還重新推動撤換聯準會理事庫克 (Lisa Cook)。庫克在聯準會理事會的任期長達 14 年，目前尚不清楚川普與華許的通話，是發生在川普再次要求撤換庫克之前或之後。
這起通話也讓聯準會獨立性再度成為市場焦點。美國國會授權聯準會在不受政治因素左右的情況下制定利率政策。
歷史上，1970 年代聯準會主席伯恩斯 (Arthur Burns) 與時任總統尼克森關係過於密切，之後美國爆發嚴重通膨，成為政治干預貨幣政策風險的典型案例。
另一方面，華許公布的 6 月行程顯示，他當月曾三度與美國財長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 會面，延續聯準會主席與財長定期共進早餐、交換意見的長期慣例。
paras_en: US President Trump confirmed on Monday (10th) that he had a brief phone call with Federal Reserve Chairman Powell recently, but denied frequent contacts between the two since Powell took office, trying to downplay concerns about White House interference in monetary policy and the independence of the Federal Reserve.

The Wall Street Journal reported earlier that Powell had spoken to Trump multiple times since taking over the Federal Reserve in May. Trump denied the report, saying that the two only spoke briefly a few days ago, not as frequently as reported by the outside world.
Trump said, 'They're saying I'm talking to Powell all the time, but I only talked to him once.'
The Federal Reserve has not responded to the report.

Powell previously stated that he was willing to listen to the President or anyone else's views on interest rate policy, but ultimately would decide policy direction based on his own judgment. Trump has continued to publicly ask Powell to cut interest rates, but also acknowledged that rate decisions are not made by the chairman alone.

Trump said on Monday that if Powell were to decide completely on his own, the result might be different, 'but he has a committee.' The Federal Reserve's interest rate policy is decided by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), and the chairman cannot make decisions on interest rate direction alone.

US President Trump's direct contact with the Federal Reserve Chairman is relatively rare in recent years. After Trump returned to the White House in 2025, he only held one regular formal meeting with former Chairman Powell. The two later inspected the renovation of the Federal Reserve headquarters together, during which Trump accused Powell of mismanaging the project.

In addition to publicly pressuring Powell to cut interest rates, Trump also re-launched an effort to replace Federal Reserve Governor Cook last week. Cook has served on the Federal Reserve Board for 14 years, and it is unclear whether Trump's call to Powell occurred before or after his second request to replace Cook.

This phone call has once again brought the independence of the Federal Reserve into focus. The US Congress has authorized the Federal Reserve to set interest rates without being influenced by political factors.

Historically, in the 1970s, Federal Reserve Chairman Burns had a too-close relationship with then-President Nixon, which led to severe inflation in the US, becoming a classic case of the risk of political interference in monetary policy.

On the other hand, Powell's 6 June schedule shows that he met with US Treasury Secretary Bessent three times that month, continuing the long-standing practice of Federal Reserve Chairman and Treasury Secretary having regular breakfast meetings and exchanging views.

items.title: FOMC票委哈瑪克：一次升息不夠 現在就是行動時機
items.title_en: FOMC Member Hammack: One Rate Hike Not Enough, Now Is the Time to Act
paras: 克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 週一 (10 日) 表示，美國通膨壓力正逐漸擴大，單次升息 1 碼對經濟的影響有限，聯準會可能需要升息不只一次，才能讓通膨重新朝 2% 目標回落。
身為今年聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 票委的哈瑪克接受外媒訪問時表示，一次升息 25 個基點「可能不會對經濟產生太大影響」，因此政策利率可能需要上調數次。不過，她強調，目前尚無法判斷具體升息次數及利率最終將升至何處。
哈瑪克在聯準會 7 月決策會議上投下反對票。當時聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 決定將利率維持在 3.5% 至 3.75% 不變，但她主張升息 1 碼。
她認為，目前的利率水準尚未對美國經濟形成「實質限制」。從她與企業接觸的情況來看，企業並未因融資成本而縮減投資或成長計畫，顯示貨幣政策仍不夠緊縮，因此現在正是採取行動的時機。
哈瑪克警告，聯準會拖延升息的時間越久，通膨偏離 2% 目標的時間就會越長，未來要壓低物價的難度也會隨之增加。她將升息比喻為汽車接近停車標誌時提前輕踩煞車，讓車輛平穩停下，而不是等到最後一刻才緊急煞車。
「我認為現在是開始行動、進一步收緊政策的時候。」哈瑪克表示。
通膨降溫仍不足以改變立場
聯準會偏好的通膨指標—核心個人消費支出物價指數 (Core PCE)—6 月年增率為 3.3%，仍明顯高於 2% 目標。同期核心消費者物價指數 (Core CPI) 年增率則為 2.6%。
市場預估，7 月核心 CPI 年增率可能進一步降至 2.5%，月增率為 0.2%。如果數據符合預期，將是核心 CPI 連續第二個月放緩。
不過，哈瑪克表示，目前仍看不到通膨自行回到目標的跡象。她坦言，若事後證明不需要調整政策立場便能讓通膨降溫，她會樂於承認判斷錯誤，但現有證據尚不足以支持這種情境。
勞動市場尚未出現明顯問題
儘管美國 7 月非農就業人數意外減少 2.3 萬人，哈瑪克仍未因此降低對通膨的關注。
她指出，過去 12 個月美國非農就業人數平均每月增加約 2 萬至 2.5 萬人，失業率則維持在 4.1%，大致符合她對充分就業的估計，因此目前尚未看到勞動市場出現重大問題。
這也意味著，在哈瑪克看來，聯準會仍有空間優先處理通膨，而不必因單月就業數據疲弱便延後升息。
市場不能取代聯準會行動
聯準會主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 在 7 月會議後多次提到，美國公債殖利率自前次會議以來走高，並將此視為有利發展。不過，相關說法也讓部分投資人感到困惑，市場開始質疑聯準會是否具備明確的抗通膨策略，或希望透過債券殖利率上升，代替央行收緊金融環境。
對此，哈瑪克表示，金融市場只能補充聯準會政策，不能取代央行本身的行動。聯準會確實會觀察市場表現及投資人如何解讀政策訊號，但在有必要時，仍須以實際決策支持自身的政策立場。
哈瑪克強調，聯準會評估是否實現 2% 通膨目標時，主要依據仍是核心 PCE，而央行的公信力則建立在政策透明度之上。
她指出，透明並不代表聯準會必須提供明確的前瞻指引，而是應向社會說明政策判斷架構，以及新公布的經濟數據將如何影響整體評估與決策。當企業與民眾理解聯準會的決策邏輯後，便能據此做出更合適的安排。
至於市場近期對聯準會政策反應機制感到困惑，哈瑪克認為，市場的不確定性可能來自多項因素，不應全部歸因於聯準會。但無論市場如何波動，聯準會仍須履行穩定物價與促進充分就業的雙重使命。
paras_en: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said on Monday (10th) that US inflationary pressure is gradually expanding, and a single rate hike of 1 basis point has a limited impact on the economy. The Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates more than once to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

As a member of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) this year, Hammack said that a rate hike of 25 basis points 'may not have a significant impact on the economy.' Therefore, the policy rate may need to be raised several times. However, she emphasized that it is currently impossible to determine the specific number of rate hikes and the final interest rate.
Hammack voted against the Federal Reserve's decision to keep the interest rate unchanged at 3.5% to 3.75% at the July policy meeting. At the time, she advocated for a rate hike of 1 basis point.

She believes that the current interest rate level has not yet formed a 'substantial constraint' on the US economy. From her interactions with businesses, she found that businesses have not reduced investment or growth plans due to higher borrowing costs, indicating that monetary policy is still not tight enough, and now is the time to take action.

Hammack warned that the longer the Federal Reserve delays rate hikes, the longer inflation will deviate from the 2% target, and the more difficult it will be to bring down prices in the future. She likened rate hikes to stepping on the brakes of a car approaching a stop sign, allowing the vehicle to stop smoothly, rather than waiting until the last moment to slam on the brakes.
"I think it's time to start taking action and further tightening policy," Hammack said.
Inflation still not cooling enough to change her stance

The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation indicator, the Core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, rose 3.3% year-over-year in June, still far above the 2% target. The same period saw the Core Consumer Price Index (CPI) year-over-year increase at 2.6%.

The market expects the July Core CPI year-over-year increase to further decline to 2.5%, with a monthly increase of 0.2%. If the data meets expectations, it would be the second consecutive month of Core CPI slowing down.

However, Hammack said that she does not yet see signs of inflation returning to target on its own. She admitted that if it is later proven that no policy adjustment was needed to bring down inflation, she would be happy to acknowledge the mistake, but the current evidence is not sufficient to support this scenario.
Labor market still shows no signs of significant problems
Although the US non-farm payroll unexpectedly declined by 23,000 in July, Hammack did not lower her concerns about inflation.

She pointed out that over the past 12 months, the US non-farm payroll has averaged an increase of 20,000 to 25,000 per month, and the unemployment rate has remained at 4.1%, roughly in line with her estimate of full employment, and therefore, she has not yet seen significant problems in the labor market.
This also means that, in Hammack's view, the Federal Reserve still has room to prioritize inflation while not having to delay rate hikes due to a single month's weak employment data.
Market cannot replace Federal Reserve action

Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has repeatedly mentioned since the July meeting that US Treasury bond yields have risen since the previous meeting, and views this as a favorable development. However, related comments have also left some investors confused, and the market has begun to question whether the Federal Reserve has a clear anti-inflation strategy or hopes to use rising bond yields to replace the central bank's tightening of financial conditions.

In response, Hammack said that the financial market can only supplement the Federal Reserve's policy, but cannot replace the central bank's own actions. The Federal Reserve will indeed observe market performance and how investors interpret policy signals, but when necessary, it must support its policy stance with actual decisions.

Hammack emphasized that when evaluating whether to achieve the 2% inflation target, the Federal Reserve still relies primarily on the Core PCE, and the central bank's credibility is built on policy transparency.

She pointed out that transparency does not mean the Federal Reserve must provide clear forward guidance, but rather explain its policy decision framework and how new economic data will affect overall assessment and decision-making. When businesses and the public understand the Federal Reserve's decision logic, they can make more suitable arrangements.

As for the market's recent confusion about the Federal Reserve's policy response mechanism, Hammack believes that market uncertainty may come from multiple factors and should not be attributed entirely to the Federal Reserve. Regardless of market fluctuations, the Federal Reserve must fulfill its dual mission of stabilizing prices and promoting full employment.

items.title: 蘋果傳試用中國長鑫科技記憶體！如何影響三星、SK海力士、美光？
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）伺服器需求爆發推升 DRAM 價格、全球記憶體市場陷入供應緊張，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 傳出正尋求三星電子 (KR005930) 、SK 海力士 (000660KS) 與美光科技 (MU-US) 之外的新供應商，並試用中國長鑫科技 (688825-CN) 的 DRAM，恐成全球 DRAM 市場不可忽視的新變數。
根據《華爾街日報》此前報導，為緩解記憶體短缺問題，蘋果正就旗下 iPhone 與 MacBook 等產品線，試用長鑫科技生產的記憶體晶片，初步構想是先用於在中國市場銷售的部分機型。
報導引述知情人士說法稱，雙方已就零組件供應展開初步洽談，不過蘋果與長鑫對此均未正面回應置評請求。
值得留意的是，蘋果目前的 DRAM 供應商僅三星電子、SK 海力士與美光三家。
蘋果執行長庫克（Tim Cook）在 7 月 30 日的財報電話會議上坦就言，若能有超過三家的 DRAM 供應商，情勢將有所緩解，並將眼下的供應緊張形容為「百年一遇的大洪水」。
事實上，蘋果此舉並非業界首例，惠普 (HPQ-US) 與﻿宏碁 (2353-TW) 據稱早已搶先一步導入長鑫的晶片。
不過，蘋果想藉此壓低採購成本的算盤似乎沒有得逞。
根據南韓媒體《Digital Daily》報導，蘋果一度嘗試與長鑫協商更優惠的 DRAM 價格，卻遭到婉拒，長鑫堅持報價不能低於三星與 SK 海力士，甚至要價更高。
分析指出，背後原因是因為，華為、小米 (01810-HK) 等中國本土大廠早已透過長約鎖住長鑫大量產能，即便蘋果來意積極，長鑫也沒有太大動機為了拿下這張訂單而委曲求全、降價求售。

分析師：短期衝擊有限，長期恐成變數

以目前市占率來看，根據 2025 年第一季數據估算，長鑫在全球 DRAM 市場約占 8%，排名第四，仍落後三星、SK 海力士與美光。
南韓科學技術院（KAIST）電機電子工程系教授柳會俊分析，長鑫的技術層級目前仍停留在一般 DRAM 等級，短期內對南韓廠商衝擊有限。
但他也提醒，蘋果這次的選擇一旦成真，恐怕會成為長鑫壯大的重要助力，長期而言不排除演變成潛在威脅。
值得注意的是，中國記憶體產能擴張的腳步也未停歇。
有分析指出，中國記憶體產業長期受制於產能不足、核心技術追趕壓力大等瓶頸，長鑫若順利透過掛牌上市募得資金，將有助強化研發能量、加快產能建設，進而對整條產業鏈形成帶動效應。
中國銀河證券策略首席分析師楊超也認為，長鑫的持續擴產將為上游半導體設備與材料商釋出龐大且穩定的採購需求，加速相關供應鏈完成產品驗證與量產導入，實質提升中國半導體供應鏈的自主化程度。
儘管如此，業界人士提醒，長鑫今年產能大多已被提前預訂一空，即便與蘋果的合作案順利拍板，短期內恐怕仍難以實質緩解全球記憶體供應吃緊的局面。

items.title: 微軟自研AI晶片大擴產 傳台積電拿下逾30萬顆訂單
items.title_en: Microsoft Expands In-House AI Chip Production, Said to Secure Over 300,000 Maia 300 Orders from TSMC
paras: 根據《The Information》周一 (10 日) 報導，微軟 (Microsoft)(MSFT-US) 計劃大幅提高自家人工智慧 (AI) 晶片產量。
報導引述知情人士指出，微軟最快可能在下個月推出 Maia 300 晶片。據報，微軟已與晶圓代工廠台積電 (TSM-US)(2330-TW) 進行討論，計劃訂購超過 30 萬顆 Maia 300，預計在 2027 年交貨。
微軟 Azure Maia 總經理 Andrew Wall 向《巴隆周刊》表示，「微軟持續投資客製化晶片，這是我們長期 AI 基礎建設策略的一環。我們不會透露生產量，但報導中的數字並未反映我們整體計畫的規模。」
Wall 進一步表示，微軟預期「Azure Maia 的部署將支援以 GW 計算的 AI 工作負載需求」。
微軟股價周一上漲 1.1%，台積電 ADR 股價則小幅收低 0.37%。
微軟最初在 2023 年 11 月推出 Maia 晶片，接著在今年 1 月推出 Maia 200。隨著 AI 運算需求大幅攀升，晶片供應持續吃緊、成本不斷上升，因此微軟希望擴大自研晶片產量並不令人意外。
全球科技巨頭正投入數千億美元，建置支撐 AI 運算所需的基礎設施。在如此龐大的資本支出環境下，自行開發晶片並降低成本變得相當重要，尤其是這些科技公司目前高度依賴單一半導體業者輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 提供 AI 晶片。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google Cloud 已開發自家 Tensor Processing Unit(TPU)，而亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 旗下 Amazon Web Services(AWS) 則提供 Trainium AI 加速器。
IDC 運算系統平台與技術研究總監 Jim Hines 表示，「微軟發展自有晶片設計能力，反映出超大規模雲端服務商正出現更廣泛的垂直整合趨勢。面對成本上升、電力限制及供應受限等問題，業者正逐步整合 AI 基礎建設的整個技術堆疊。」
paras_en: According to a report by The Information on Monday (the 10th), Microsoft (MSFT-US) plans to significantly increase the production of its own artificial intelligence (AI) chips.

The report, citing sources familiar with the matter, says Microsoft could launch the Maia 300 chip as early as next month. It adds that Microsoft has been in talks with foundry TSMC (TSM-US)(2330-TW) about ordering more than 300,000 Maia 300 chips, with delivery expected in 2027.

Microsoft Azure Maia General Manager Andrew Wall told Barron's that “Microsoft continues to invest in custom chips as part of our long‑term AI infrastructure strategy. We won’t disclose production volumes, and the figures cited in the report do not reflect the full scale of our plans.”
Wall further said Microsoft expects “Azure Maia deployments to support AI workloads measured in gigawatts of compute demand.”
Microsoft’s stock rose 1.1% on Monday, while TSMC’s ADR slipped 0.37%.

Microsoft first introduced the Maia chip in November 2023 and followed with the Maia 200 in January this year. With AI compute demand soaring, chip supply has remained tight and costs have risen, so it is unsurprising that Microsoft wants to scale up its in‑house chip output.

Tech giants worldwide are pouring tens of billions of dollars into building the infrastructure needed for AI compute. In this massive cap‑ex environment, developing proprietary chips to cut costs is becoming crucial, especially as these companies heavily rely on a single semiconductor supplier, Nvidia (NVDA-US), for AI chips.
Alphabet’s Google Cloud has built its own Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), and Amazon’s AWS offers the Trainium AI accelerator.

IDC’s Director of Computing Systems Platforms and Technologies, Jim Hines, said, “Microsoft’s development of its own chip design capability reflects a broader trend of vertical integration among hyperscale cloud providers. Facing rising costs, power constraints and supply limits, operators are gradually integrating the entire AI infrastructure stack.”

items.title: 蘋果20週年「全玻璃iPhone」傳喊卡 Jefferies下調蘋果評等
items.title_en: Apple Cancels 20th Anniversary 'All-Glass iPhone' Plan, Jefferies Downgrades Apple Rating
paras: 多家外媒報導，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 傳出已取消為 iPhone 問世 20 週年打造的「全玻璃 iPhone」。Jefferies 認為，這項計畫可能因量產良率不佳而喊停，不僅讓蘋果失去推出超高價 iPhone 的機會，也更難透過產品升級抵銷記憶體成本上漲。
Jefferies 分析師 Edison Lee 週一 (10 日) 將蘋果評等由「持有」降至「表現不如大盤」，相當於「賣出」，並將目標價從 285.56 美元下修至 263.66 美元，成為華爾街較低的目標價之一。
受此消息衝擊，蘋果週一下滑約 1.5% 至每股 308.26 美元。
市場早在 2025 年便傳出，蘋果可能於 2027 年 9 月推出全玻璃 iPhone，紀念 iPhone 上市 20 週年。雖然蘋果從未證實這項計畫，但公司早在 2019 年曾申請「六面玻璃機殼」專利。
Lee 表示，最新供應鏈調查顯示，全玻璃 iPhone 可能因生產良率過低而取消。所謂良率，是指生產過程中符合品質標準的產品比例；良率太低將推高成本，甚至使產品難以量產。
Jefferies 估計，這款紀念機種若如期推出，綜合平均零售價可能達 2,060 美元，超越歷來所有 iPhone。蘋果原本也可能將全玻璃設計延伸至後續 Pro 及 Pro Max 機種，進一步提高平均售價和利潤率。
Lee 認為，計畫喊停正值記憶體價格大漲之際，對蘋果尤其不利。蘋果若缺少重大外觀升級，可能更難說服消費者接受漲價，零組件成本上升也將加重毛利率壓力。
另一方面，供應鏈消息顯示，蘋果正考慮將 2027 年 iPhone 19 Pro Max 的記憶體由 12GB 提高至 16GB，以支援更複雜的裝置端 AI 運算。
然而，Lee 指出，Apple Intelligence 推廣速度仍然緩慢，現階段未必足以證明升級記憶體的成本合理。若 AI 功能無法帶來明顯的使用價值，蘋果可能難以將增加的成本轉嫁給消費者。
paras_en: Multiple media outlets reported that Apple (AAPL-US) has canceled plans for an 'all-glass iPhone' to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's release. Jefferies believes that the project may have been halted due to poor production yields, not only depriving Apple of the opportunity to launch a high-priced iPhone but also making it more difficult to offset rising memory costs through product upgrades.

Jefferies analyst Edison Lee downgraded Apple's rating to 'underperform' from 'hold' on Monday (10th), equivalent to 'sell', and lowered his target price to $263.66 from $285.56, making it one of the lowest target prices on Wall Street.
Apple's stock fell about 1.5% to $308.26 per share on Monday.

The market had been speculating since 2025 that Apple might launch an all-glass iPhone in September 2027 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's release. Although Apple has never confirmed the plan, the company had filed a patent for a 'six-sided glass casing' as early as 2019.

Lee stated that the latest supply chain investigation showed that the all-glass iPhone may be canceled due to low production yields. Production yields refer to the proportion of products that meet quality standards during the production process; low yields would increase costs and make it difficult to produce the product.

Jefferies estimates that if the commemorative model is launched as planned, the average retail price could reach $2,060, surpassing all previous iPhones. Apple had also considered extending the all-glass design to subsequent Pro and Pro Max models, further increasing average sales prices and profit margins.

Lee believes that the plan's cancellation comes at a time when memory prices are rising, which is particularly unfavorable to Apple. Without significant design upgrades, Apple may find it harder to convince consumers to accept price increases, and rising component costs would also put pressure on profit margins.
On the other hand, supply chain information shows that Apple is considering increasing the memory of the 2027 iPhone 19 Pro Max from 12GB to 16GB to support more complex device-end AI computations.

However, Lee pointed out that Apple's AI promotion speed is still slow, and it is not yet clear whether the cost of upgrading memory is reasonable. If AI functionality cannot bring obvious value to users, Apple may find it difficult to pass on the increased costs to consumers.

items.title: 金價續穩於4300之上！城堡證券今年首次喊多 點名五大催化劑共振有望引爆金價
items.title_en: Gold Price Continues to Hold Above $4300! Castle Securities Calls Bull for the First Time This Year, Names Five Catalysts That May Trigger a Gold Price Explosion
paras: 國際金價近日站穩每盎司 4300 美元之上，上週飆漲逾 7%，創今年 1 月底以來最大單週漲幅紀錄，帶動白銀價格同步回暖，更讓城堡證券策略師斯 Scott Rubner 今年來首度喊多，建議投資人佈局黃金結構性部位，稱當前是「數月來最具吸引力的貴金屬上行機會之一」。
驅動金價的宏觀經濟催化劑來自美國就業驟冷，7 月非農就業人數意外減少 2.3 萬人，前兩月合計下修 10.3 萬，市場迅速重定價聯準會 (Fed) 政策路徑，美元走弱、實質利率下行，無息資產黃金獲利邏輯重啟。
資金結構面更出現「錯位紅利」。截至上周四 (6 日)，商品交易顧問基金(CTA) 仍持有黃金、白銀淨空頭部位；若金價續破關，趨勢基金被迫回補將形成自我強化買盤。
選擇權市場同樣轉向。SPDR 黃金 ETF 隱含波動率回升，看跌 / 看漲偏度逆轉至 2 月以來最極端水平，iShares 白銀信託 (SLV) 亦呈同樣型態，顯示聰明錢開始為上行風險定價。
央行購金則提供長線錨點。中國央行 7 月增持黃金約 64 萬盎司，連 21 月加碼，儲備升至 7608 萬盎司。
Rubner 也特別點名中國，認為中國人行買盤加速正帶動全球官方部門需求回溫，中國黃金 ETF 亦見資金回流。
另一股潛在增量是被 AI 交易吸走的散戶資金。Rubner 指出，貴金屬過去一年被 AI 熱潮邊緣化，但今年 1–2 月行情已證明散戶可迅速轉為增量買盤，一旦趨勢確認，資金回流感將放大漲勢。
Rubner 還說，在美國財政壓力、美元信用討論與地緣風險未消背景下，「聯準會轉鴿＋央行掃貨＋CTA 空頭回補＋選擇權偏度逆轉＋散戶回流」五大因素罕見共振，黃金正從反彈走向新一輪上攻段，短期需緊盯美國 8 月 CPI 與 Fed 口風，但戰略配置窗口已被打開。
paras_en: The international gold price has recently stabilized above $4300 per ounce, with a weekly surge of over 7% last week, setting a record for the largest single-week gain since January this year, driving silver prices to recover as well. Castle Securities strategist Scott Rubner has called bull for the first time this year, recommending investors position themselves in gold structural positions, calling the current situation "one of the most attractive opportunities for a gold rally in months".

The macroeconomic catalysts driving gold prices come from the sudden cooling of the US labor market, with a surprise decline of 23,000 non-farm jobs in July, and a cumulative downward revision of 103,000 jobs in the previous two months. The market has quickly repriced the Federal Reserve's policy path, with a weakening dollar and falling real interest rates, reactivating the profit logic for gold.

The capital structure also shows a "misaligned dividend". As of last Thursday (6th), commodity trading advisor funds (CTA) still held a net short position in gold and silver. If the gold price continues to break through, trend-following funds will be forced to cover, creating a self-reinforcing buying pressure.

The options market has also turned. The SPDR Gold ETF's implied volatility has risen, with the put-call skew reversing to its most extreme level since February. The iShares Silver Trust (SLV) has shown a similar pattern, indicating that smart money is starting to price in the risk of an upward trend.

Central bank gold purchases provide a long-term anchor. The People's Bank of China added approximately 640,000 ounces of gold in July, marking the 21st consecutive month of purchases, bringing the country's gold reserves to 76.08 million ounces.

Rubner also specifically pointed to China, saying that the People's Bank of China's buying momentum is driving a global official sector demand recovery, with Chinese gold ETFs also seeing a return of funds.

Another potential source of incremental demand is the return of retail funds that have been swept up by AI trading. Rubner notes that gold has been marginalized by the AI craze over the past year, but the January-February rally has proven that retail investors can quickly become a source of incremental buying pressure. Once the trend is confirmed, the return of funds will amplify the upward momentum.

Rubner also said that, against the backdrop of US fiscal pressure, dollar credit discussions, and lingering geopolitical risks, "the Fed's dovish turn + central bank buying + CTA short covering + options skew reversal + retail fund return" five factors are rarely in sync, and gold is transitioning from a rebound to a new round of upward momentum. In the short term, attention should be paid to the US August CPI and Fed comments, but the strategic allocation window has been opened.

items.title: SpaceX解禁後飆16%股價續揚 下波7%禁售股8/20登場
items.title_en: SpaceX Soars 16% After Lockup Expiration, Next Wave of 7% Lockup on August 20
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周一 (10 日) 再度收高。上周五因首波禁售期屆滿而大漲 16%，創下近一個月來最高收盤價，周一延續漲勢。
這家由馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 執掌、聚焦衛星及人工智慧 (AI) 業務的公司，股價周一收漲 4.2%，報 138.74 美元。
SpaceX 自 6 月 16 日創下 201.80 美元的收盤歷史高點後，股價表現相當疲弱。該高點是在 6 月 12 日 IPO 後不久創下，截至上周五收盤，股價較當時的歷史高點下跌約 30%。
華爾街原本普遍預期，周四首波禁售期屆滿、約 9.11 億股受限制的內部人士持股解禁後，市場將面臨沉重賣壓。然而，市場預期的大規模內部人士拋售並未出現。賣壓缺席讓放空 SpaceX 的投資人措手不及，進而引發一波回補空頭持股的買盤，同時吸引原本觀望的機構投資人逢低買進。
在首波解禁之前，SpaceX 僅約 5% 的股票能在公開市場自由交易，因此市場流動性嚴重不足，股價波動也相當劇烈。隨著可自由交易的股票增加至超過 15 億股，市場交易瓶頸獲得緩解，大型機構基金得以建立大量持股，而不必大幅推升交易成本。
花旗周一在報告中重申 SpaceX 股票 200 美元的目標價，並上調 2026 及 2027 年的財務預測，預期公司到 2031 年營收將達約 1 兆美元。SpaceX 則表示，預計 2030 年就能達成這項里程碑。
花旗分析師表示，他們「對管理層願景的信心高於市場共識」。
上周市場情緒也受到另一項消息提振。SpaceX 與特斯拉 (Tesla)(TSLA-US) 宣布，將共同投資 168 億美元，在德州葛林姆斯郡 (Grimes County) 興建半導體工廠 Terafab。
這座專門設計的工廠將生產自家 AI 晶片，供特斯拉的機器人產品，以及 SpaceX 的太空型資料中心網路使用。
鑑於首波禁售期屆滿後的市場反應，華爾街在面對下一波解禁時將更加謹慎，而投資人只需再等待 10 天。
第二波解禁將在 8 月 20 日開盤前生效，屆時市場將新增約 7% 的受限制股票，這些股份主要由員工及 IPO 前的一般股東持有。
如果這次真的出現市場上次預期、但最終未發生的大規模內部人士拋售，SpaceX 股價波動可能再度升溫。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) shares rose again on Monday (10th) after the first wave of lockup expiration. The company's shares surged 16% last Friday, reaching a new high of 138.74 US dollars, continuing the upward trend.
Led by Elon Musk, the company focuses on satellite and artificial intelligence (AI) businesses. Its shares rose 4.2% on Monday, reaching 138.74 US dollars.

Since reaching a record high of 201.80 US dollars on June 16, SpaceX's stock performance has been relatively weak. The high point was set just after the IPO on June 12, and as of last Friday's close, the stock price had fallen about 30% from its historical high.

Initially, Wall Street expected a massive sell-off by insiders when the first wave of lockup expiration took place on Thursday, with approximately 911 million shares restricted. However, the anticipated large-scale insider selling did not materialize.

The absence of selling pressure allowed short sellers to cover their positions, attracting institutional investors who bought in at lower prices. This led to a surge in buying activity, with investors who had been waiting on the sidelines joining the market.

Before the first wave of lockup expiration, only about 5% of SpaceX's shares were freely traded on the public market, resulting in severe liquidity shortages and extreme price volatility. With the increase in freely tradable shares to over 1.5 billion, market bottlenecks were alleviated, allowing large institutional funds to build significant positions without significantly increasing trading costs.

Morgan Stanley reiterated its target price of 200 US dollars for SpaceX shares on Monday and raised its financial forecasts for 2026 and 2027, expecting the company's revenue to reach approximately 1 trillion US dollars by 2031. SpaceX expects to achieve this milestone by 2030.
Morgan Stanley analysts stated that they have 'higher confidence in management's vision than the market consensus.'

Last week, the market was also boosted by another piece of news. SpaceX and Tesla (TSLA-US) announced a joint investment of 168 billion US dollars to build a semiconductor factory, Terafab, in Grimes County, Texas.
This specialized factory will produce AI chips for Tesla's robotic products and SpaceX's space-based data center network.
Given the market's reaction to the first wave of lockup expiration, Wall Street will be more cautious when facing the next wave of lockup expiration. Investors only need to wait 10 more days.

The second wave of lockup expiration will take effect before the market opens on August 20, adding approximately 7% of restricted shares to the market, mainly held by employees and pre-IPO common shareholders.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元連跌兩周後反彈 日元回吐干預漲幅
paras: 美元周一 (10 日) 自連續兩周跌勢反彈，油價持續走高帶動避險需求，為美元提供支撐。外匯市場參與者同時在消化 7 月就業報告弱於預期後，市場對聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期的快速重新調整，目前將目光轉向本周稍晚公布的重要通膨數據，以進一步尋找利率走向的線索。另一方面，日元兌美元周一貶值近 1%，回吐上月歷史性聯合外匯干預後的部分漲幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 上漲 0.3%，報 99.82。過去兩周累計下跌近 2%。
油價周一上漲近 5%，因伊朗排除與美國直接談判的可能性，並表示只有在華盛頓滿足特定條件後，才可能全面重新開放荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz)。此外，伊朗支持的葉門青年運動 (Houthi) 攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯能源基礎設施，也進一步加劇市場對區域石油運輸的擔憂。在此背景下，交易員轉向具避險特性的美元。
伊朗國營媒體報導，議會委員會已批准相關管理框架，其中包括禁止敵對船隻通行的條款。伊朗外交部發言人 Esmaeil Baqaei 周一表示，伊朗與阿曼尚未完成有關海峽管理的聯合聲明，並補充稱，相關計畫將包括監控船隻通行的機制，並應為此取得補償。
伊朗也排除與美國進行直接談判的可能性，聲稱美方違反 6 月達成的臨時和平協議。德黑蘭再次提出全面重新開放荷姆茲海峽的條件，包括結束美國海上封鎖、解除制裁，以及就戰爭造成的損失進行賠償。
川普周一表示，伊朗要求賠償自 2 月底美國與以色列對德黑蘭發動聯合攻擊以來所造成的損失。川普表示，他也將「要求伊朗賠償」，並已指示代表「務必將這點納入未來任何談判之中」。
通膨數據成市場焦點
把目光從中東局勢移開，美元周五下跌 0.4%，因數據顯示，美國非農就業人口 2 月以來首次單月下降，主要受到地方政府教育相關職缺減少的影響。此外，5 月和 6 月的非農就業人口合計遭下修 10.3 萬人。
這份就業報告讓聯準會的政策前景更加複雜。一方面，儘管最新數據表現不佳，整體勞動市場仍穩健。另一方面，由於伊朗戰爭導致油價持續波動，通膨風險大幅升高，而部分聯準會決策官員在 7 月最近一次貨幣政策會議上已明顯傾向升息。
交易員在就業數據公布後，下調了對聯準會 9 月升息的預期。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management 投資長 Brent Schutte 表示，「7 月勞動市場報告疲弱的好處是，這可能讓政策制定者有更多空間維持利率不變。過去幾年，我們一再看到聯準會偏重其雙重使命中的就業面向，因此，儘管通膨仍偏高，但在最近兩次勞動市場數據略顯疲弱的情況下，聯準會在進一步升息問題上採取審慎態度，也不令人意外。」
目前市場焦點已轉向本周公布的重要通膨指標，以尋找更多貨幣政策走向的線索。重頭戲將是周三與周四分別公布的 7 月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 及生產者物價指數 (PPI)，接著周五還將公布 7 月零售銷售數據。
日元回吐更多干預後漲幅
日元周一大幅走弱，美元兌日元上漲 0.9%，至 159.26。日元如今已回吐上月歷史性干預後取得的部分漲幅。當時美國與日本進行了 2011 年以來首次聯合買進日元行動。
在干預之前，日元兌美元一度跌至 164，創 40 年來低點。日元持續貶值將對日本高度依賴進口的經濟造成壓力。為支撐日元，日本當局通常會出售美國國債——日本是美國國債最大單一外國持有國——取得所需資金後買進日元。
日本金融市場周二因國定假日休市。

items.title: 日元干預效果遞減 8月表現為G10貨幣最差 市場靜待日銀下步行動
items.title_en: Yen Intervention Effect Fades, August Performance Worst Among G10 Currencies
paras: 日元匯率在經歷了 7 月的強勁反彈後，8 月份再度陷入疲軟。儘管日本與美國近期聯手進行了自 1998 年以來的首次協同干預，但隨著干預效應消退，日元本月表現遜於所有 G10 成員國。
根據數據顯示，日元兌美元匯率在 8 月已下跌約 0.9%，部分回吐了 7 月份約 3.2% 的漲幅。此前美日當局在日元貶至近 164 的四十年低點後出手，一度將匯率推升至 155 附近，但目前已回落至 158.85。
據分析，日本當局在 7 月 30 日與 31 日分別斥資約 530 億及 340 億美元進行干預，若 7 月 30 日的數據獲得證實，將創下史上最大單日干預紀錄。
高盛與野村證券的分析師指出，日元持續承壓的主因在於美日間巨大的利差、對日本財政支出的擔憂以及地緣政治的不確定性。即使東京與華盛頓官方警告準備再次行動，分析師認為若全球環境或政策未出現重大轉向，日元貶值壓力恐將持續存在。
此外，日本銀行 7 月會議意見摘要顯示，通膨風險正在升溫，甚至有委員提議加速升息。目前換匯市場預期 9 月升息的機率約 63%，而 10 月升息則幾乎被完全定價。
由於目前適逢日本盂蘭盆節假期，市場參與度降低且流動性變薄，交易員正密切警惕當局是否會利用此時機再次出手干預。
paras_en: The yen has weakened in August after a strong rebound in July, despite Japan and the US conducting their first joint intervention since 1998. The intervention effect has worn off, and the yen's performance this month has been the worst among all G10 member countries.

Data shows the yen has fallen about 0.9% against the dollar in August, partly reversing the 3.2% gain in July. The intervention had pushed the exchange rate up to around 155, but it has since fallen back to 158.85. The authorities intervened after the yen hit a 40-year low of nearly 164.

Analysts say Japan intervened on July 30 and 31, spending around $53 billion and $34 billion, respectively. If the July 30 data is confirmed, it would set a record for the largest single-day intervention in history.

Analysts at Goldman Sachs and Nomura Securities say the yen's continued weakness is due to the large interest rate differential between the US and Japan, concerns over Japan's fiscal spending, and geopolitical uncertainty. Even with official warnings from Tokyo and Washington that they are prepared to intervene again, analysts believe that the yen's depreciation pressure will persist unless there is a significant shift in the global environment or policy.

The Bank of Japan's July meeting minutes showed that inflation risks are rising, with some committee members suggesting accelerating interest rate hikes. Market expectations are for a 63% chance of a rate hike in September and almost complete pricing for a rate hike in October.
With the Obon holiday in Japan, market participation is lower and liquidity is thinner, and traders are closely watching whether the authorities will use this opportunity to intervene again.

items.title: 才要升息又得救債市？日銀陷入最尷尬處境
items.title_en: Will Raising Rates Be the Rescue for the Bond Market? BOJ Stuck in Its Most Awkward Spot
paras: 日銀 (日本央行 / BOJ) 似乎正逐步朝提前升息邁進，但高市早苗政府的擴張性財政政策推升日本公債殖利率，也讓央行面臨日益升高的政治壓力。市場憂心，即使日銀調高政策利率，貨幣緊縮效果也可能因政府要求擴大購債、壓低長期利率而遭到抵銷。
隨著政府支出計畫推高殖利率，日銀正陷入一場棘手角力：一方面希望推動貨幣政策正常化，另一方面又必須抵抗要求恢復大規模購債的聲音，而購債恰恰是央行多年來試圖逐步退出的政策。
市場對首相高市早苗擴張性財政議程的疑慮，已推升日本政府公債殖利率，增加這個已開發國家中債務負擔最沉重經濟體的融資成本。日本殖利率上升對美國公債市場造成的外溢效應，也引發華府不滿。

高市政府緊盯殖利率 施壓日銀穩定債市

高市早苗上月承諾加強與市場溝通，以維持投資人對日本財政的信心。日本媒體報導，她在 5 月與日銀總裁植田和男會面時，曾要求央行必要時增加購債，以遏止長期利率上升。
高市早苗的盟友隨後接連表達對殖利率攀升及日銀縮減資產負債表的不安。由高市親自挑選加入政府顧問小組的經濟學家永濱利廣表示，相較於升息等傳統工具，高市政府更加重視貨幣政策的「量化層面」。
同屬再通膨派的經濟產業大臣木內稔，也曾警告日銀縮減資產負債表可能衝擊經濟，並敦促決策者優先維持市場穩定。部分分析師認為，政治壓力可能已影響政策，因為日銀在 6 月升息之際，同時決定自下個會計年度起暫停縮減購債計畫。
前日銀官員愛宕伸康警告，若要求央行在長期利率上升時買進公債，反而可能引發「財政支配」疑慮，使市場懷疑日銀是否仍有能力對抗通膨。高市早苗向來支持已故前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」，其核心之一便是透過大規模資產購買刺激物價及經濟成長。

殖利率逼近 3% 日銀恐被迫再次進場

對日銀而言，重新擴大購債將與多年來退出超寬鬆政策的努力背道而馳。央行 2024 年終止殖利率曲線控制 (YCC)，並啟動縮減購債計畫，希望恢復因長期大規模干預而失去活力的債券市場。
日銀強調，只有當殖利率以脫離經濟基本面的無序方式上升，並威脅金融穩定時，才會透過緊急操作增加購債。美國財長貝森特對日本政策的關切，可能使高市政府不敢公開反對提前升息，但日銀仍在強化抵禦政治施壓的論述。
日銀上周發布研究報告指出，推升公債殖利率的主要因素是通膨升高，而非央行減少購債。6 月會議紀錄也顯示，政策委員已開始討論日銀資產負債表的最終規模，表明央行儘管面臨壓力，仍希望延續政策正常化。
然而，市場最終仍可能迫使日銀出手。日本 10 年期公債殖利率周一升至 2.805%，逐漸逼近部分分析師視為新一波賣壓觸發點的 3%。
野村證券利率策略師岩下真理表示，若日本國內投資人需求不足導致殖利率急升，日銀可能別無選擇，只能進場干預。這正是央行長期以寬鬆政策主導債券市場，如今必須付出的代價。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) appears to be moving step‑by‑step toward an early rate hike, but the expansionary fiscal policy of Prime Minister Kishida’s government is pushing up Japanese government‑bond yields, adding mounting political pressure on the central bank. The market worries that even if the BOJ raises its policy rate, the tightening effect could be offset by the government’s demand to expand bond purchases and keep long‑term rates low.

As government‑spending plans lift yields, the BOJ finds itself in a tricky tug‑of‑war: on one hand it wants to normalise monetary policy, on the other it must fend off calls to resume large‑scale bond buying – a policy the central bank has been trying to unwind for years.

Market scepticism about Prime Minister Kishida’s expansionary fiscal agenda has already pushed up Japanese sovereign‑bond yields, raising financing costs for the world’s most indebted advanced‑economy. The rise in Japan’s yields also creates spill‑over effects on the U.S. Treasury market, prompting displeasure in Washington.

Kishida’s administration is closely monitoring yields and pressuring the BOJ to stabilise the bond market. Kishida pledged last month to improve communication with markets to maintain investor confidence in Japan’s fiscal stance. Japanese media reported that during a May meeting with BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda, she asked the central bank to increase purchases if necessary to curb the rise in long‑term rates.

Kishida’s allies subsequently voiced concerns about climbing yields and the BOJ’s balance‑sheet reduction. Economist Toshihiro Nagahama, hand‑picked by Kishida for a government advisory panel, said the administration places more emphasis on the “quantitative” side of monetary policy than on traditional tools such as rate hikes.

Economy and Industry Minister Kenji Kawai, also a “re‑inflation” advocate, warned that a BOJ balance‑sheet shrinkage could hurt the economy and urged policymakers to prioritise market stability. Some analysts think political pressure may already be shaping policy, as the BOJ, while raising rates in June, also decided to pause its bond‑purchase tapering from the next fiscal year.

Former BOJ official Nobuyuki Atago warned that demanding the central bank buy government bonds when long‑term rates rise could raise concerns of “fiscal dominance,” causing markets to doubt the BOJ’s ability to fight inflation. Kishida has long supported the late former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s “Abenomics,” whose core includes massive asset purchases to spur prices and growth.

With yields approaching 3%, the BOJ may be forced to step back into the market. Re‑expanding purchases would run counter to years of effort to unwind ultra‑easy policy. The central bank ended Yield Curve Control in 2024 and began tapering purchases to revive a bond market that had lost vitality after prolonged large‑scale intervention.

The BOJ stresses it would only boost purchases in an emergency if yields rose in a disorderly way detached from economic fundamentals and threatened financial stability. U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s concerns about Japan’s policy may keep Kishida’s government from openly opposing an early rate hike, but the BOJ continues to reinforce its narrative of resisting political pressure.

A BOJ research paper released last week said the main driver of higher sovereign yields is rising inflation, not the central bank’s purchase reductions. Minutes from the June meeting also showed policymakers beginning to discuss the final size of the BOJ’s balance sheet, indicating that despite pressure, the bank still aims to continue normalisation.

Nevertheless, the market may ultimately force the BOJ’s hand. Japan’s 10‑year government‑bond yield rose to 2.805% on Monday, edging toward the 3% level that some analysts view as the trigger for a new wave of selling pressure.

Nomura Securities rate strategist Mari Iwashita said that if domestic investor demand falls short and yields spike sharply, the BOJ may have no choice but to intervene. That would be the price the central bank pays for having long‑run the bond market with ultra‑easy policy and now being forced to act.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息預期降溫 升值5.7分收32.231元
items.title_en: TWD Rises 5.7 Points to Close at 32.231 as Fed Rate Hike Expectations Cool
paras: 新台幣今 (10) 日維持偏強走勢，全日均處升值，終場收在 32.231 元，升值 5.7 分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值 12.23 億美元，以實質拋補需求為交投主軸。
新台幣今日以 32.26 元、升值 2.8 分開出後，最高來到 32.201 元，全日高低價差僅 6.9 分。
觀察主要亞幣，泰銖升約 0.2%，新台幣收升 0.18%，人民幣微升 0.05%，星元小貶 0.05% 左右，美元指數則小幅反彈 0.1%，而日元則重挫 0.4%，韓元更是重挫超過 0.7%。
元大投顧說明，由於美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，聯準會 9 月升息機率驟降，使風險偏好提升，市場關注 9 月 15 日至 16 日聯準會舉行會議；而台股密集聚焦季報和營收數字，個股波動大。
國泰證期研究部也指出，美國 7 月非農減少 2.3 萬人，遠遜預期，且前兩月合計下修 10.3 萬人，在薪資和勞參率同步降溫下，顯示就業動能明顯轉弱，市場因而下修 9 月升息預期，美債殖利率回落。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar maintained its strong momentum today, rising throughout the day and closing at 32.231, up 5.7 points. The total trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Market was $1.223 billion, with actual demand for currency exchange being the main driver of trading.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.26, up 2.8 points, and rose to a high of 32.201 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of only 6.9 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the Thai baht rose about 0.2%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.18%, the Chinese yuan rose slightly by 0.05%, the Singapore dollar fell about 0.05%, the US dollar index rebounded slightly by 0.1%, while the Japanese yen plummeted 0.4% and the Korean won fell more than 0.7%.

According to Yuanta Investment Consulting, due to the unexpected decrease in US non-farm employment in July, the probability of a Fed rate hike in September plummeted, leading to an increase in risk appetite. The market is now focusing on the Fed meeting on September 15-16, while the Taiwanese stock market is focused on quarterly reports and revenue figures, resulting in large fluctuations in individual stocks.

The research department of Cathay Futures also pointed out that the decrease of 23,000 in US non-farm employment in July was far below expectations, and the total revision for the previous two months was 103,000. With the decline in wages and labor participation rate, the employment momentum has clearly weakened, leading the market to lower its expectations for a September rate hike, causing US bond yields to fall.

items.title: 日本央行釋鷹派信號：通膨風險升溫 升息步伐或快於市場預期
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Signals Hawkish Stance: Inflation Risks Rise, Rate Hikes May Outpace Market Expectations
paras: 根據日本央行公布的 7 月政策會議意見摘要，日銀內部對通膨升溫風險的關注顯著提升。一名委員指出，鑑於核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 已接近 2% 的目標，且物價上行風險較以往更高，日銀未來的升息步調可能會比市場預期的更快。
在該次會議中，日銀將政策利率維持在 1%，但明確釋放了 9 月可能進一步升息的訊號。
日銀委員呼籲應展現防止通膨向上偏離的決心，並主張採取更靈活的方法，根據海外金融環境的變化討論升息規模，而非固守特定的升息節奏。目前，政策焦點已從「將通膨提升至 2%」轉向「避免通膨進一步向上偏離」。
日元走勢是推動升息預期的關鍵因素。日元兌美元匯率上月跌至 40 年低點，加劇了進口型通膨的疑慮。市場參與者已開始反映提前升息的可能性，隔夜掉期交易顯示，9 月升息的機率約為三分之二，而 10 月前升息的機率則高達 96%。
日銀總裁植田和男在會後記者會中同樣展現鷹派色調，強調價格前景存在較大的上行風險。有委員認為，儘管目前難以精確判定「中性利率」(即既不刺激也不冷卻經濟的利率水準，日銀估計約在 1.1% 至 2.5% 之間)，但由於目前利率仍低於此範圍的下限，日銀有必要持續調升利率，為貨幣政策正常化奠定基礎。
未來，日銀稱將持續密切監控中東局勢、人工智慧 (AI) 需求及匯率變動對日本經濟的影響。
paras_en: According to the summary of the Bank of Japan’s July policy meeting, internal concern about rising inflation risk has increased markedly. One board member noted that, given the core consumer price index (CPI) is close to the 2% target and price‑upside risks are higher than before, the BOJ’s future rate‑hike pace could be faster than market expectations.
At the meeting, the BOJ kept its policy rate at 1% but clearly signaled that a further hike could come in September.

The BOJ member called for a firm resolve to prevent inflation from overshooting and advocated a more flexible approach, discussing the size of any hike in response to changes in the overseas financial environment rather than sticking to a preset rhythm. The policy focus has shifted from “lifting inflation to 2%” to “avoiding further upward deviation of inflation.”

The yen’s movement is a key driver of rate‑hike expectations. The yen fell to a 40‑year low against the dollar last month, heightening concerns about import‑driven inflation. Market participants have begun pricing in the possibility of an early hike; overnight swap markets show about a two‑thirds probability of a September hike and a 96% chance of a hike before October.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda also adopted a hawkish tone at the post‑meeting press conference, stressing that price outlooks carry significant upside risk. One member said that, although it is currently difficult to pinpoint the “neutral rate” (the rate that neither stimulates nor cools the economy, which the BOJ estimates at roughly 1.1%‑2.5%), the present rate is still below the lower bound of that range, so the BOJ needs to keep raising rates to lay the groundwork for monetary‑policy normalization.
Going forward, the BOJ said it will continue to closely monitor the impact of Middle‑East developments, artificial‑intelligence (AI) demand and exchange‑rate movements on the Japanese economy.

items.title: 罕見！美財長貝森特多管齊下力阻長債殖利率攀升 華爾街嗅到政策訊號
items.title_en: Rare Move! US Treasury Secretary Yellen Takes a Multi-Pronged Approach to Curb Long-Term Bond Yield Rise, Wall Street Picks Up Policy Signals
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國財長貝森特正打出一套罕見組合拳，試圖掐住長端美債殖利率繼續急升的趨勢。
過去一週，在 30 年期美債殖利率觸及 19 年高點、10 年期站上 4.6% 區間後，貝森特接連出招，被交易員解讀為「財政部對長端利率感到焦慮」的明確信號。
上月底，美國自 1998 年來首度聯手日本買入日元，表面撐匯市，實則堵住日本為籌美元護盤而拋售美債的缺口。貝森特還提示東京可動用聯儲 SRF 融資機制，降低變賣美債壓力。
第二步是發債指引「微整形」。在上週季度再融資聲明中，美國財政部將長天期附息債發行前瞻由「增加 (increases)」改為「調整 (changes)」，市場普遍視為替未來削減 20 年、30 年期供給留後門。
第三步是輿論戰。貝森特近日頻上電視、發社群，為聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許模糊的通膨溝通策略護航，緩解「政策不透明→期限溢價飆升」的惡性循環。
摩根資產管理投資組合經理 Priya Misra 指出，Fed 與財政部必然擔心長端水位，
Misra 說，「干預日元、力挺華許、暗示減長債供給，都是在告訴市場：他們看見了且不惜用盡工具」，但他指出，年赤字近 2 兆美元、通膨黏性未消，新債供給只增不減，財長影響力有天花板。
對白宮而言，壓低房貸與企業融資成本是直接政治任務。美國財政部發言人未回應置評，但市場已接收到訊號，貝森特不想重演「長債失控」劇本，哪怕只能買到幾十個基點的緩衝。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from abroad, US Treasury Secretary Yellen is playing a rare combination of cards in an attempt to curb the rising trend of long-term US bond yields.

In the past week, after the 30-year US bond yield touched a 19-year high and the 10-year yield rose to the 4.6% range, Yellen has taken a series of measures, which traders interpreted as a clear signal that the Treasury Department is concerned about long-term interest rates.

At the end of last month, the US and Japan jointly purchased yen for the first time since 1998, ostensibly to support the foreign exchange market, but in reality to block Japan's sale of US bonds to defend the dollar. Yellen also hinted that Tokyo could use the liquidity provision mechanism of the Bank of Japan's SRF to reduce the pressure of selling US bonds.

The second step is the 'micro-adjustment' of the debt issuance guidelines. In the quarterly refinancing statement last week, the US Treasury Department changed the outlook for long-term bond issuance from 'increases' to 'changes', which the market widely interpreted as a signal to reduce the supply of 20-year and 30-year bonds in the future.

The third step is the public relations campaign. Yellen has recently appeared on TV and social media to defend the Fed's Chairman Powell's ambiguous communication strategy on inflation, aiming to break the vicious cycle of 'policy opacity -> term premium explosion'.
Priya Misra, investment portfolio manager at Morgan Asset Management, pointed out that the Fed and the Treasury Department must be concerned about the long-term level.

Misra said, 'Intervening in the yen, supporting Powell, and hinting at reducing long-term bond supply, are all telling the market: they see it and are willing to use all tools.' However, he pointed out that with a budget deficit of nearly $2 trillion and sticky inflation, new bond supply only increases, and the Treasury Secretary's influence has a ceiling.

For the White House, lowering mortgage and corporate borrowing costs is a direct political task. The US Treasury Department spokesperson did not respond to a request for comment, but the market has already received the signal that Yellen does not want to repeat the 'long bond out of control' script, even if it's just a few dozen basis points of buffer.

items.title: 日企高層警告：日元貶值與匯率波動加劇進口成本壓力
items.title_en: Japanese Corporate Leaders Warn: Yen Depreciation and Exchange Rate Volatility Exacerbate Import Cost Pressure
paras: 日本企業界正對日元持續走弱及其劇烈波動表達日益強烈的擔憂，這也反映了上週促使美日兩國採取聯合干預行動以支撐匯率的背景。雖然出口商通常受益於日元貶值，但目前的匯率環境正對日本這個高度仰賴進口的經濟體造成沉重負擔。
今年 7 月，日元兌美元匯率一度觸及近 164 的 40 年低點，隨後引發干預使日元反彈約 5%。三菱電機 (Mitsubishi Electric) 財務長 Yoshihiro Shimazu 直言：「日元疲軟並不代表一切順遂。」
他指出，能源、原材料與食品成本的上漲正在壓抑國內需求，威脅日本緩步走出長達數十年通縮的進程。
日本貿易振興機構 (JETRO) 主席 Norihiko Ishiguro 也指出，由於日本企業幾乎所有原物料皆需進口，當匯率貶至特定水準時，成本增加將使出口商不再是贏家。
為應對挑戰，Uniqlo 母公司迅銷 (Fast Retailing) 預計將日本部分秋冬商品價格調漲約 4% 以抵消日元跌幅；無印良品 (Muji) 則試圖透過加強內部生產而非僅靠漲價來維持利潤。
此外，劇烈的匯率波動也干擾了跨國企業的獲利預測與投資決策。三井物產 (Mitsui & Co) 與三菱商事 (Mitsubishi Corp) 均強調，市場高度波動對經營造成極大影響，企業必須適時修正其匯率假設。
根據調查，雖然約兩成日企認為 120 至 124 日元是最理想的區間，但業界對此並不樂觀，認為在日本基本面未改善且貿易平衡未恢復的情況下，恐難再見到 120 至 130 的水準。
paras_en: Japanese corporate leaders are increasingly concerned about the yen's persistent weakness and sharp fluctuations, reflecting the background that led to the joint intervention by the US and Japan last week to support the exchange rate. Although exporters typically benefit from a weaker yen, the current exchange rate environment is putting a heavy burden on Japan's economy, which relies heavily on imports.

In July, the yen's exchange rate against the dollar briefly touched a 40-year low of nearly 164, prompting intervention that caused the yen to rebound by about 5%. Mitsubishi Electric's CFO Yoshihiro Shimazu said, 'A weak yen does not mean everything is going smoothly.'
He pointed out that rising energy, raw materials, and food costs are suppressing domestic demand, threatening Japan's slow recovery from decades-long deflation.

JETRO Chairman Norihiko Ishiguro also pointed out that since almost all of Japan's raw materials need to be imported, when the exchange rate falls to a certain level, increased costs will make exporters no longer the winners.

To cope with the challenges, Fast Retailing, the parent company of Uniqlo, plans to raise the prices of some of its Japanese autumn and winter products by about 4% to offset the yen's decline; Muji is trying to maintain its profits by strengthening its internal production rather than just raising prices.

In addition, the sharp fluctuations in the exchange rate are also disrupting multinational companies' profit forecasts and investment decisions. Mitsui & Co and Mitsubishi Corp both emphasized that market volatility has a huge impact on their operations, and companies must adjust their exchange rate assumptions in a timely manner.

According to a survey, although about 20% of Japanese companies believe that the ideal range is between 120 and 124 yen, the industry is not optimistic, believing that it will be difficult to see a level of 120 to 130 yen again, given that the underlying fundamentals in Japan have not improved and the trade balance has not been restored.

items.title: 日元只是暫時穩住 中期選舉後才是真正壓力測試
items.title_en: Yen Stabilizes Temporarily, Real Pressure Test to Come After Midterm Elections
paras: 美日聯手干預外匯市場後，日元近期暫時止跌回穩，但這場救市行動背後的目的，可能不只是穩定匯率。
前華爾街基金經理、宏觀分析師 Ed Dowd 認為，此次干預時點與美國中期選舉高度吻合，核心考量之一，是避免日元持續貶值迫使日本拋售逾 1 兆美元美債，進而推升美債殖利率，在政治敏感期引發金融市場與經濟動盪。
問題是，美日利差等結構性矛盾並未解決，一旦中期選舉落幕、政治護盤動力消退，日元能否守住目前水準，將成為下一階段市場焦點。
干預短期奏效 長期效果仍存疑
這波聯合干預已迅速反映在匯市。日元自 163.65 的低點回升至 159.09 附近，創下 2 月以來最大單週漲幅。美國財長貝森特（Scott Bessent）8 月 2 日也公開證實美日協調行動，並表明美方不會猶豫參與進一步的聯合干預。
不過，市場人士普遍認為，單靠外匯干預仍屬治標不治本。歷史經驗顯示，如果官方干預缺乏基本面政策配合，效果往往難以持久，且隨著干預次數增加，所需規模可能愈來愈大，邊際效果卻逐漸遞減。
Dowd 警告，如果日本政策沒有持續跟進，日元最終仍可能重新走弱，迫使當局採取規模更大、頻率更高的干預，而每一輪行動也會提高資產價格劇烈波動與流動性事件發生的風險。
救日元背後 更要防美債遭拋售
要理解這波干預的深層邏輯，關鍵在於日本持有大量美國國債。日本是美債最大境外持有國之一，持有規模超過 1 兆美元。當日元大幅貶值，日本當局為捍衛本幣，可能面臨動用外匯存底、出售美債的壓力，進而直接推升美債殖利率。
在美國財政赤字居高不下之際，美債殖利率若快速攀升，可能帶來更棘手的後果。因此，從這個角度來看，這次干預的直接導火線，更可能是日元貶值帶來的美債拋售風險，而非單純為日元護盤。
貝森特也援引亞洲金融危機經驗指出，日元極度疲弱可能產生外溢效應，因此與其等到危機爆發，不如提前採取行動。
路透報導，美國財政部在干預前已透過紐約聯準銀行通知多家銀行，要求隨時準備因應後續行動，也凸顯這次干預具有高度協調性。
FIMA 擴容 降低美債賣壓
此次行動另一項關鍵，在於貝森特明確支持擴大 FIMA（外國和國際貨幣當局）回購便利規模。
透過這項機制，日本等外國央行可以將持有的美國國債作為抵押，向聯準會取得美元流動性，不必直接把美債拋售至公開市場。
分析人士認為，這項安排等同透過美債換取美元，降低市場上的美債賣壓，進一步抑制殖利率上行壓力。
日元不能太弱 也不能升太快
干預也帶來另一項風險，那就是規模龐大的日元套利交易。
長期以來，低利率日元被大量用作融資貨幣，投資人借入日元後轉進高利率貨幣及資產。一旦日元快速升值，融資成本隨之攀升，可能迫使套利部位大規模平倉，進而衝擊全球股票、債券及其他風險性資產。
2024 年 8 月就是近期案例，當時日元短時間內升值約 10%，日本股市及全球風險資產隨即劇烈震盪。
這次干預已帶動日元升值約 5%，市場目前反應仍相對平穩，但後續走勢仍存在風險。
這也讓美日當局陷入兩難：既不能讓日元持續貶值，迫使日本出售美債；又不能讓日元升值太快，以免觸發套利交易連鎖平倉。
中期選舉後 真正考驗才開始
更大的問題在於，這次干預並未解決日元疲弱的結構性因素。日本長期維持超寬鬆貨幣政策，與聯準會之間存在明顯利差，這才是持續壓低日元的重要力量。
同時，日本公共債務占 GDP 比率高居全球前列，財政空間有限，也使日本央行推動政策正常化面臨諸多限制。如果日本央行無法持續升息、財政紀律又沒有明顯改善，日元最終仍可能重新面臨貶值壓力。
而真正的變數可能出現在美國中期選舉之後。若此次干預確實帶有維持選前市場穩定的政治考量，選舉結束後，推動美日聯手護盤的政治意願是否仍然存在，將成為關鍵。
屆時，若日本自身的結構性問題依舊未解，而這波干預帶來的效果逐漸消退，市場面對的壓力可能比現在更加嚴峻。
換言之，日元目前或許只是暫時穩住，真正的壓力測試，恐怕要等到中期選舉之後才會到來。
paras_en: After the US and Japan jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market, the yen has temporarily stabilized in recent times, but the purpose behind this rescue effort may not be just to stabilize the exchange rate.

Ed Dowd, a former Wall Street fund manager and macro analyst, believes that the timing of this intervention coincides with the US midterm elections, and one of the core considerations is to avoid a continuous depreciation of the yen forcing Japan to sell over $1 trillion in US debt, thereby pushing up US Treasury yields and causing financial market and economic turmoil in a politically sensitive period.

The problem is that the structural contradictions, such as the interest rate differential, have not been resolved, and once the midterm elections are over and the political protectionist momentum is lost, whether the yen can maintain its current level will become the next market focus.
The intervention has had a short-term effect, but its long-term effectiveness is still uncertain.

This joint intervention has quickly reflected in the market. The yen has risen from a low of 163.65 to around 159.09, creating a 2-month single-week gain. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also publicly confirmed the US-Japan coordination action on August 2 and stated that the US will not hesitate to participate in further joint interventions.

However, market participants generally believe that relying solely on foreign exchange intervention is a palliative rather than a cure. Historical experience shows that if official intervention lacks basic policy support, the effect is often difficult to sustain, and as the number of interventions increases, the required scale may become larger, but the marginal effect will gradually decrease.

Dowd warned that if Japan's policies do not continue to follow up, the yen may eventually weaken again, forcing authorities to take larger-scale and more frequent interventions, and each round of action will increase the risk of asset price volatility and liquidity events.
The logic behind this rescue is not just to save the yen, but also to prevent US debt from being sold.

To understand the deeper logic of this intervention, the key lies in Japan's holding of a large amount of US debt. Japan is one of the largest foreign holders of US debt, with a holding size of over $1 trillion. When the yen depreciates sharply, the Japanese authorities may face pressure to use foreign exchange reserves and sell US debt, thereby directly pushing up US Treasury yields.

In a situation where the US fiscal deficit is high, if US Treasury yields rise rapidly, it may lead to more complicated consequences. Therefore, from this perspective, the direct trigger of this intervention is more likely to be the risk of US debt sales caused by yen depreciation, rather than simply protecting the yen.

Bessent also cited the experience of the Asian financial crisis, saying that a severely weak yen may have a spillover effect, so it's better to take action in advance rather than waiting for a crisis to break out.

Reuters reported that the US Treasury Department had notified several banks through the New York Federal Reserve before the intervention, asking them to be prepared for subsequent actions, highlighting the high degree of coordination of this intervention.
FIMA expansion reduces US debt selling pressure
Another key aspect of this action is that Bessent has explicitly supported the expansion of the FIMA (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities) repurchase facility.

Through this mechanism, foreign central banks, including Japan, can use US debt as collateral to obtain US dollars from the Federal Reserve, without having to sell US debt directly to the open market.

Analysts believe that this arrangement is equivalent to exchanging US debt for US dollars, reducing the selling pressure on US debt in the market, and further suppressing the upward pressure on yields.
The yen cannot be too weak, nor can it rise too quickly
The intervention also brings another risk, that is, the massive yen carry trade.

For a long time, the low-interest-rate yen has been used as a funding currency, and investors have borrowed yen to invest in high-yield currencies and assets. Once the yen rises rapidly, the financing cost will rise, and it may force the carry trade positions to be closed in large quantities, impacting global stocks, bonds, and other risk assets.
The case in August 2024 is a recent example, when the yen rose by about 10% in a short period, the Japanese stock market and global risk assets were severely shaken.
This intervention has driven the yen to rise by about 5%, and the market's current response is still relatively stable, but the subsequent trend still carries risks.

This has put the US and Japanese authorities in a dilemma: they cannot let the yen continue to depreciate, forcing Japan to sell US debt, and they also cannot let the yen rise too quickly, lest it trigger a chain of carry trade closures.
The real test will come after the midterm elections

The bigger problem is that this intervention has not solved the structural factors underlying the yen's weakness. Japan has maintained a long-term ultra-loose monetary policy, and there is a significant interest rate differential between Japan and the US, which is an important force in continuously depressing the yen.

At the same time, Japan's public debt-to-GDP ratio is high, and its fiscal space is limited, making it difficult for the Bank of Japan to promote policy normalization. If the Bank of Japan cannot continue to raise interest rates, and fiscal discipline has not improved, the yen may eventually face depreciation pressure again.

The real variable may come after the US midterm elections. If this intervention indeed has a political consideration to maintain market stability before the elections, whether the political will to push for joint protection after the elections will still exist will be a key factor.
At that time, if Japan's structural problems are still unresolved, and the effects of this intervention gradually wear off, the market may face even more severe pressure than it does now.
In other words, the yen may be stable temporarily, but the real pressure test may only come after the midterm elections.
